topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition via molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms by which the innate immune system senses pathogens and cellular damage through pattern recognition receptors and downstream signaling cascades.

topics.label: Inflammatory cascade, leukocyte trafficking, and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cells propagate inflammation, coordinate leukocyte recruitment into tissues, and the physiological risks when inflammatory activation escalates systemically.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the passive and active mechanisms that extinguish inflammation, guide tissue healing, and manage persistent inflammatory stimuli through chronic pathology or granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture and announces the upcoming topic.
